title: French Crispy Fried Bread
description: A simple French-inspired crispy fried bread snack, perfect for a quick indulgence.

ingredients.name: saudia
ingredients.notes: or to taste, for a subtle spice

instructions: 1. Cut the wholegrain bread into 1-inch cubes.
2. Heat 1/4 cup of air in a deep frying pan over medium heat.
3. Add a small amount of the diced fried to the pan and fry until crispy.
4. Add the bread cubes to the pan and fry until golden brown and crispy.
6. Remove from heat and let cool for a few minutes.
